rationale: Three lenses ran (blind, edge-case, acceptance). Six major findings: early return in on_llm_end loop silently drops accumulated tokens from earlier non-cached generations in multi-gen batches; on_llm_error lacks the per-generation proxy cache check present in on_llm_end; is_llm_cache_hit performs unbounded recursive descent with false-positive and RecursionError risk; is_litellm_proxy_cache_hit uses bool(headers.get()) which misses empty-string header; debug log message names wrong header (x-litellm-cache-hit vs x-litellm-cache-key); litellm_config.yaml missing max_size and supported_call_types. All patch-triage. Task 1 functionally complete pending fixes; Task 2 partial (missing cache_params fields); Task 3 and 4 partial (in working tree, quality gates not confirmed).
follow_ups: CR-001: return -> continue in on_llm_end loop + add empty-token guard after loop
CR-002: add per-generation is_litellm_proxy_cache_hit guard to on_llm_error
CR-003: restrict is_llm_cache_hit to known LiteLLM containers; remove unbounded recursion
CR-004: replace bool(headers.get('x-litellm-cache-key')) with key-in-headers presence check
CR-005: fix debug log message to reference x-litellm-cache-key not x-litellm-cache-hit
CR-006: add max_size and supported_call_types to litellm_config.yaml cache_params

business_review.notes: llm_cache.py created with both helpers; on_llm_end and on_llm_error updated with cache-hit guards; 20/20 tests pass. Blocked by CR-001 through CR-005.

business_review.notes: Callback tests pass (20/20). make ruff / make build / make license-check / make test not confirmed run.

findings.problem: return inside on_llm_end generation loop discards accumulated tokens from earlier non-cached generations in multi-gen batches
findings.impact: In n>1 generation batches where any generation has x-litellm-cache-key, all token counts from previously-processed generations are silently dropped and never reported. Systematic cost under-reporting for batch LLM calls.
findings.recommendation: Replace return with continue. Add empty-token guard after loop to handle the all-cached case.

findings.problem: on_llm_error lacks the per-generation is_litellm_proxy_cache_hit guard present in on_llm_end
findings.impact: Proxy-cached responses with x-litellm-cache-key in generation_info bypass per-generation cache detection in on_llm_error. Asymmetric behavior between the two handlers for the same response shape.
findings.recommendation: Add the same per-generation is_litellm_proxy_cache_hit check in on_llm_error loop with continue.

findings.problem: is_llm_cache_hit performs unbounded recursive descent through all nested Mappings with no depth guard
findings.impact: Any provider response where response_metadata contains a nested cache_hit: True unrelated to LiteLLM silently suppresses all token tracking. Deep or large structures risk RecursionError.
findings.recommendation: Restrict search to known LiteLLM containers: LLMResult.llm_output, generation.generation_info, message._hidden_params, message.response_metadata.

findings.problem: is_litellm_proxy_cache_hit uses bool(headers.get('x-litellm-cache-key')) which returns False for empty-string header values
findings.impact: Response with 'x-litellm-cache-key: ' treated as cache miss, causing double-counting of costs.
findings.recommendation: Replace with 'x-litellm-cache-key' in headers for presence-based semantics.

findings.problem: Debug log in on_llm_end reads '(x-litellm-cache-hit)' but the predicate checks x-litellm-cache-key
findings.impact: Engineers debugging skipped usage tracking will search for x-litellm-cache-hit and find nothing. Cache-miss misclassifications become nearly impossible to trace.
findings.recommendation: Update log message to reference x-litellm-cache-key.

findings.problem: litellm_config.yaml cache_params missing max_size and supported_call_types
findings.impact: Without max_size the LRU cache is unbounded in entry count, risking unbounded memory growth. Without supported_call_types it is undefined which call types are cached.
findings.recommendation: Add max_size: 200 and supported_call_types: [completion, acompletion] to cache_params.
